events.title: Premium Candle Product Shot
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

events.text:
A premium candle shot works well with soft, directional lighting, a simple background, and plenty of breathing room.

**Upload a photo of your candle**, and I can use it to create the shot while preserving its packaging and label. My suggested direction: warm ivory stone, gentle shadows, and a subtle glow from the wick—elegant without too many props.

If you don’t have a photo yet, tell me the candle’s brand name, scent, and jar color, and we can create a concept instead.
